validation_queries.description: Device sampling covers exactly two GPU agents
validation_queries.error_message: --gpus=0-1 did not limit PMC sampling to exactly two GPU agents
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT info.agent_id) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.target_arch = 'GPU'
